race.title: PricedUp Boosted Prices Daily Bud Booth Mares' Chase (Listed) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: KALA CONTI advertised her well-being with a comfortable success at Down Royal on her return and Gordon Elliott's Grade 2-winning mare looks the way to go up in trip. Bluey is feared most on the back of an encouraging Aintree reappearance third. KALA CONTI (FR) BLUEY (IRE) RUBY ISLAND
race.bettingForecast: Kala Conti (4/6), Bluey (3/1), Ruby Island (5/1), Jasmine Bliss (14/1), Overabottleofred (33/1)
